name: Reframe

provenance.note: editor framing keys (EdlZoom: scale, cx, cy)

summary: Follow the action inside a wide shot: from the speaker to the screen, from one card to the next.

data.about: Glides the frame so a point (`at`) becomes the centre, with an optional change of size (amount, default none).
data.avoid: Jumps of more than half a frame (cut instead); when the point leaves the source (it shows the edge).
